contentList.content: I understand. A new type of ambition has grown within me, these last months. This illithid form is... powerful.
I've devoted myself to rebuilding the city. A life of diplomacy and compromise.
When will I see you again?
My home is with Astarion.
*The future of the githyanki rests in your hands. And you know just how to mould it.*
Business Boom - Take Your Troubles to the House of Grief
I am the eyes and ears of my Lord.
Letter from Arnell Hallowleaf
Have you heard word from Orpheus since his departure?
Then we'll kill it.
No. I have chosen my path. I am a Warrior of the Comet.
Bar
You? Hm. Always nice to me. Always give me pets. Yes. Will bite for you! Will fight for you!
A less ceremonious exit than I expected. Not that I'm complaining.
All right - I'll catch up with you later. But don't get to any of the fun stuff without me - got it?
*A rush of pleasure wells up within you at the thought.*
Bhaal has a new Chosen in Baldur's Gate - Orin. I suspect she's behind this.
I obey the just laws of this realm, not the unjust laws of the Astral Plane.
Is our little hatchling Xan secure in his portable hole?
The Crying God's faithful thought it a sign. They summoned me the very next day.
There is one consolation - Gale's soul is mine now, a new resident in my House of Hope. Perhaps you'll come to visit one day.
You're not paying enough for this, skeleton! Cheap husk!
A dog-eared copy of the Baldur's Mouth Gazette.
This is your decision, Lae'zel. Make it count.
When the innocent of the Coast are in danger, the Blade will always come calling.
I assure you, this is merely the prelude to a far grander vision. Elysium's in for something of a shake-up.
How lovely to see the others doing well. As long as they're not doing too well, of course.
Yes, I suppose you're above the baser pleasures of life now. A pity: they're often the most fun.
Moonblessed Adventurer
Divinity would have been nice, it's true...
I know you're doing what's best for Karlach. If the roles were reversed, I'd have done the same.
I have no regrets in any case. I chose a life with you, and haven't looked back.
This night shall be done sooner than any of us would like. I hope we meet again.
I wish I could. But I must see to vital city business.

If Cazador progresses the ritual
[1]
more times, he will sacrifice all the spawn and ascend!
Please try not to poison me next time we kiss.
Total Points
That three-tusked orthon? My heart still races thinking about it.
Chk. The Hellswalker returns.
Dubious Emperor
Fat bastards, all of them. Was on the heels of a merregon who'd been stalking the Wild Hills and sprinted a little too close to the Styx.
New Feat!
He still believes in the bow and the blade. But with Florrick's help, he's teaching the Fist a new lesson:
You want to hear about the amnizu at the Styx, the three-tusked orthon, or the invading goristroi?
Teaching wizardlings to crack skulls? Sounds like fun.
When your time comes, the Gate's grandest statue will be made of you, right in the heart of the Wide. The hero of our age, and the last.
It's quite... ahem, yes really quite lovely.
I need no invitation - upholding the law is my mandate.
Lolth
| Performance |
Naturally. The god of ambition has an ambitious larder to match. I'm not exactly fighting for scraps.
*A chance to meet with the friends and allies who were by your side in the battle against the Absolute.*
That can't have been easy. Glad you've got backup.
Damage increased by [1].
Good luck, Gale. Don't forget me when you're a god.
Kelemvor
It's better for me to be far from the city, given Mizora's influence on me.
I crashed the party with wanton aggression, and the reunion of alllies ended.
I wish I could blame destiny, or tell myself that Bhaal was just too powerful to resist, but no... No, you chose this.
If you don't kill another creature before the end of your next turn, you will die instantly.
Lick your dagger-blade.
Grave Repulsion
Slayer's Extra Attack
I've seen him more than a few times. And he's as proud of me as I am of him.
Arms Out
Our journey together granted me unprecedented clarity. I feel more connected to my Ki than ever.
Our people find honour in the fact our city always comes back fighting fit - on the streets, I see hope on every face.
If you're worried about neglecting your duties back home, don't be - they'll manage for one night.
Classic Gold Frame
If only Orpheus could have shared in your victories.
I've been fighting, recruiting - and gained powerful allies. The Comet will soon crush the lich queen.
Well, now. You can make yourself presentable, when you have a mind to.
How did I go two hundred years without seeing that face?
You would think someone of my vintage would be inured to the passage of time, yet these past six months have seemed endless without your company. But now our paths cross once more...
*Cutting through the dreadful buzz of the wasps and the screams of the damned, a familiar, comforting voice echoed in your mind - Withers.*
This projection will have to do. I hope you weren't expecting a hug.
You're looking well. It seems Grand Duking suits you.
I should hope not - if any city-sized craters should appear in Faerûn, I'll know who to blame.
I shall be honoured to speak of you to the children. To embrace change as you have shall make for a stirring example. Thank you.
Please tell me you're opening a bath house in the Gate. When I get out, I'm going to need to soak for years to wash off the stink of Avernus.
Such a ward ought to empower whoever stands astride it. Let us find out.
Jolly good. I'll tell Mrs Dekarios to be expecting you. Oh, she'll be delighted. Things just haven't been the same without himself cluttering up the place.
Gods, this is a nice break from the Hells, though.
Leave.
It's still hard to believe. The great warrior Lae'zel, on a diplomatic mission.
Our love was always unbound - free to flow where greater forces would dictate. And still, you have found yourself here before me once again, if only for a night.
He made his choice. That's not on me.
Well, you pull it off admirably, I must admit. I'm sure you'll find plenty who'll fawn at the idea of a romantic fugitive.
Manage Account
I am here to see the others. Not you.
You fucking better! Gods, imagine being at death's door and the person you love the most is flying off on a fucking dragon?!
I can pinch you, if you're afraid this isn't real?
I'm afraid not. If you could encourage the correct recipient to come forward at their earliest convenience, that would be most appreciated.
It's good to be among friends again, isn't it?
Grasping Appendage
Curious choice for such an occasion - but I am merely the tune-plucker. So it shall be.
I don't expect a soldier or street-sweeper to see through the schemes of a tyrant like Gortash.
Perhaps the next time we meet, we'll have grander conquests to toast.
Of course, I don't begrudge you your choice. I just... well, wish things were different.
You couldn't be more wrong - I'm happy with the choices I made.
These books are arranged with an unusual, but fastidious, organising system - one much older than the books it keeps in order.
I suppose you've earned a little indulgence - or a lot.
It's so nice to see everyone!
I enjoyed my time in Baldur's Gate. It gave me a taste for more.
Drink
Not so much changed as reverted. Back to skulking in the dark, though I do it better now.
I'm glad, Halsin. I feel the same way.
Agh... I'm going to enjoy myself, and you can't stop me. Back to the shadows with you.
You knew how important that was to me. I'm glad he's dead - but I deserved to be there.
Me, I've seen no end to them. The trolls I've torn open, the ghouls I've cleaved - the stories I've been itching to tell.
My kill count's much lower, I fear - though I slip away for a hunt when I can. I may no longer be the Blade, but my heart is never far from the frontiers.
Oh. And for Happy, also.
Humble materials crafted with a light touch. This outfit is strong enough to withstand the elements but delicate as a sliver of moon.
We created a potion using the mushrooms Omeluum asked us for. We should bring it to him.
You must be contained. You will go to prison, and ask for the strongest handcuffs they have.
I'd like to think I'm cunning enough to get away with it. Come here to me...
*The city needs Grand Duke Ravengard more than ever. The city needs you.*
Cast every doubt from your mind. The Moonmaiden doesn't shine her light on the unworthy.
I swear, Karlach and I have felled enough cambions to build a fortress with their horns.
You look tired. What say we find you a home? How about with Halsin?

The only thing I fear is the ever-growing size of your ego. Gale.

That should do nicely. It'll be worth the trek back, I promise. We can go in your own time, but let's be careful advance too far forwards. I'd hate for us to miss our chance because events took a turn.
Do what you must, for yourself and for Karlach. I will be here waiting for you. Always.
You are here among allies - which among them would you dispose of?
As you wish. I have business of my own to attend to, after all.
Aren't you worried about losing control of them?
Yes, well, that's to be expected. They never were anything without us.
*A thousand thousand respiring things lie below, pointing up at you, gasping their last.*
You confine yourself to the School of Illusion? I'd have thought you could teach the entire curriculum...
So, you really did it - you became a god. It almost makes my ascension look trivial.
I love it, presuming I'm the hero.
Player 2
Oh I don't know. I think there's something very appealing about the idea of godhood...
That's the beauty of it - we're in no hurry. We can do what we like now. Besides, you'll need someone to patch you up from time to time.
The false heir's head will make a fine trophy for Vlaakith. As for you -
Well-Cobbled Boots
They do! Honestly, that man...
I've been enjoying the solitude of life on the road, going where I'm wanted, and staying no longer than I'm needed.
Hard to imagine there was a time when I didn't have you to hold me.
But mere survival was not enough. Not for Gale, and not for you.
I checked it myself. The master of masons was reluctant to release funds for work in the Outer City, but your neighbours proved... persuasive.
Tombstone
Of course they do. You're the life of the party.
Not to be overly pedantic, but they are my powers now.
Those runes - Cazzy's using them to suck the power right out of those poor fuckers.
I'm telling you, this is a mistake.
Lick your dagger-blade.
I discovered a book about the dragon Ansur. This could be the key to finding a way into the Wyrmway - Ansur's secret lair.
*You embody the four pillars of power: Courage, insight, strategy, and justice.*
Karlach and I are each other's home, in wild Avernus.
Anyway, I'll need to visit the doctor on our way home.
To each of us. May we each find the contentment we deserve.
*The Comet soon rises on the githyanki empire. Vlaakith will fall to Orpheus and his guard; the slates will be writ anew.*
I tried a sly approach, but the whelp saw me coming and up it flew. Poison poured from its mouth as it descended.
Avernus is my hunting ground now, but at least I have Karlach for company.
I'd already given my soul when I became a mind flayer. I had to take the chance at something greater.
Do you really want to try taking the Crown from a god, Raphael?
Hilarious. You could find work as a jester, if you stumble upon a noble with more gold than taste.
I've missed you, girl. Like, I've really missed you. My old friend Shadowheart. Hang on, why do you smell like hay?
Seems you've found your true calling. I envy you.
What about the egg you took with you? Has it hatched?
You had better, or I'll hunt you down myself.
If this fine music continues, Boo might take to dancing.
After everything we pulled off together, a little slice of normalcy sounds like just the thing - even to an illithid god of ambition.
Wyll Ravengard, Blade of Avernus! The name does not do him justice - hell fears his arrows, fists and well-placed kicks, also.
I would object, but sitting by the fire while you do all the hard work sounds marvellous, actually.
They've heard of you, if it's any consolation.
: The host of the game you tried to join is blocked on the Larian Network.
This is worse than playing Elturel - after the fall!

Moradin

Letter from Elminster
We may never be dance partners. But we have fellowship, and I wouldn't trade that for all the gold in the Gate Counting House.
*Then, and only then, Father will be proud.*
Take control of nearby spiders with a borrowed piece of drow magic.
Hells - no one's surviving a spell that powerful. Give him all you've got!
Yellow Ribbon
No blow debases more than playing for you.
Still, I mustn't frighten them with my newfound powers...
Call yourself a slayer of monsters and be proud, for that is what you are.
I've been with Astarion - trying to find a way to cure him.
I've been getting acquainted with the length and breadth of Faerûn - there's a lot to see, now that I'm free from Shar.
That's quite a gathering hearing it out loud. We need to get your father a gift for taking care of them while we're away.
Lily Aurora Ravengard. Treasure of a girl, found at the entrance of the Open Hand Temple - one grey eye, one brown.
It is the only thing.
Heroes' Scroll B
Stay eager a little longer - I'll come back to you later.
Rusty Flail
Honestly? I've been missing all of you.
Despite myself, I did miss you.
Sorry for the interruption. I have a tendency to pounce on people I don't like.
Might I steal a kiss from you?
We can agree that you have become a better man.
We've spilled blood, gained a foothold in the Astral. But still, we need allies. And one beyond reckoning has made himself known.
You finally found a place where you could talk all day and everyone had to listen to you? You must be elated.
The owlbear?!
I'm sure he'll come around, in a millennium or so, and by then my creed will be something to reckon with.
A gith hatchling is not a lab rat! This shka'keth should be bled dry for the mere suggestion.
What is 'normal'? You and I were born to do extraordinary things - we have challenged the gods and live to tell of it.
Oh twist my arm and break it, why don't you...
Postage Stamp B
You will always be a scared little spawn.
I'm not interested in any stories, Wyll.
We found the resignation letter for the master of the 'beast' that killed Holli the Waveservant. Looks like both beast and master have fled the city. We should report back to Allandra Grey.
And I'm sure we're all safer for it... Probably.
Our little trio has a great deal to talk about, what with all you get up to.
I'm afraid you have another child to deal with. Minsc's been captured by the Zhentarim.
I wanted to, truly, but I suspected someone with ill intent was tailing me. I didn't want to lead them to your door.
*He requested your attendance in Faerun, to gather with your friends and allies, those who stood against the Absolute at your side.*
My attendance was far from certain. The war against Vlaakith fills my days with blood and glory.
To peace and prosperity. You will make an excellent Grand Duke, Wyll Ravengard.
The Blade of Avernus is on the hunt. The Hells shudder at the very mention of his name.
A tale of battle told by the Blade of Frontiers, the Heart of the Gate? I'm all ears!
Styx devils, they're called. They usually prefer the frozen wastes of Stygia, but Zariel's got a few of her own for guarding the River of Blood.
Helping an ally is its own reward. But I can think of few greater challenges than battling across the Hells.
Aspect of Athkatla
Do you ever miss walking in the sun?
I made an effort. This is a special night, after all.
Absolute's Enemy
How's the city faring? A lot's changed, I imagine.
Perhaps Lae'zel and I can give the lecture together.
Reach out to embrace her.
I'm just glad we made it on time. You did take quite a while to get ready...
*Shar will protect you from their whispers and conspiracies. She loves you. She must.*
Generic Voice 1 Male
You cannot bear to be apart from me, I see?
Some strange githyanki adage, I assume? I'm not sure I want to know...
Tell me... are you happy with the path we tread together? I took you from a life of high adventure, to one that can be described as anything but.
You've found a lover, a partner. You will stay here, find your own way forward.
Abuse/Harassment
But don't worry. I'm sure you'll find there's still plenty to like, if you care to indulge...
It is earned. The young warrior I first met was desperate for the approval and favour of her queen.
Shadowheart Happy Emoji
We have shown little progress. I wonder if I've pursued an impossible task.
Sleep, rest, revel. But be ready. For thou mayest yet be needed.
Withers has plucked your spirit briefly from Elysium to observe this party - but only observe.
Courtesan
*Mizora responds with knowing silence - and a wide smile.*
But hey, I'm getting ahead of myself. Let's enjoy ourselves! This is a rare enough treat, isn't it?
Indeed he is - and with nary a lashing or scolding, to my surprise.
I always thought you had a sharp mind - your misreading of me suggests otherwise.
Shra'kt'lor? I've never heard of it. Should I have?
If anyone can survive Avernus twice, it's you.
All I want is to live free and go where I please. I can do that all by myself, without any god's intervention.
I could say the same - I haven't seen you walking the streets recently.
There's plenty to recommend it. The variety, the people, the cuisine...
Not as much as you, I'd wager. Though I have taken up a spot of teaching...
And you are mine. I'll join you in Baldur's Gate as soon as I can.
You have seen through Vlaakith's lies. Turn your back on your queen.
I have settled here well enough, though I miss being among githyanki.
I can catch everyone up on my infernal endeavours.
Killing devils, causing chaos - I can't complain.
That's so horrible...
It's not a deal, strictly speaking - more of a gentleman's agreement. 'I scratch your back, you read mine.'
Rogue
Unfortunately, in that respect some of my apprentices seem to be rather lazy.
Us Emoji
I accept. I will join you on the Council as a Grand Duke.
Thought I was done with these...
Let's start at allies and work from there.
Of course. And to ensure I do not break protocol... should I refer to the lady Mizora as your Grand Duchess?
Honestly, I was expecting you to be the one with regrets - don't you miss roaming free?
You know me. I prefer you with your clothes off...
That makes one of us. This was only ever your fight, Lae'zel - not mine.
And if anyone should believe in forgiving and forgetting, I should.
Watchful indeed. Even with my catflap of displacement, it can be hard to put my paw on you sometimes. All these adventures you insist on having...
Though I estimate I could take seven to twelve drow on my own, I'm happy to start with one.
Crown of Karsus B
Invite to Party
I'd rather hear of your own conquests.
A githzerai alliance - incredible. Could the gith unite under one sky once again?
Rather easily, actually. It turns out there are more than enough things willing to attack you in the Underdark.
I have missed you, you know. Even with your... condition.
Hnr!
You are as wise as you are eloquent, Gale. You were destined to be a teacher.

From the desk of Lorroakan, Lord of Ramazith's Tower,

I'm writing to inform you that I find myself in need of a new butler. I caught the old one spending far too much time in secret conference with the Nightsong. I do wish she'd stop distracting the staff. In any case, I've since disposed of him.

You seem good at attracting every manner of follower into your orbit. Send the most trustworthy one my way. Someone who does what they're told without too much fuss. Preferably immune to the plaints of whingeing aasimar.

Best,

Lorroakan
We come with the tide - to kill in the great god's name!
I can't say I miss it. The blood, the fleas, the looming threat of death...
You called me a devil once. I called you a fool. We were both so wrong. And together... together, we saved the world.
Before we met I fear I was rather stuck in my ways. And stuck inside my tower with a world-shattering orb of magic sealed within my chest, to be fair to myself.
Happy Hoarson
Cold and cruel, these boots would inflict serious damage if used in violence.
Tombstone
Isn't that right, Gale?
Minsc shares in your mission, friend - you pursue fiends from outside the city's walls, and Minsc will rout them from within.
Sprouting Necrosis
Mizora's missions are few and far between. I'm surprised she's afforded you so much freedom.
You are not the only one here with ambitions. It would be a pity if we came into conflict.
And it looks like life at Wyll's is suiting you...
Heroes' Scroll A
And don't you forget it!
I finally faced Cazador. It wasn't easy, but he's dead. After all these years, I'm free.
*The joy in the owlbear's eyes is clear - he would happily fight, and bite, for you.*
I stayed for love. I do not regret it.
You can thank my partner for that. Being with them has been a blessing.
So, how are you doing? Your engine isn't giving you any trouble?
Boo! Is it you who fritters about so frighteningly? If you wish to dance, then Minsc will set you down.
Oath of Devotion Paladin
Then my Fists and Council have not done enough. Come to my office tomorrow. I'll try to take on some of your burdens.
I smell fragrant flowers and a mysterious accent I can't quite place.
I am glad, genuinely. Few would make the sacrifice you did.
I wish I could see more of my parents, but we get by, and they're doing well for themselves. Perhaps one day both Wyll and I will be able to return for good.
The Blade already stands for much that our order does. There is no doubt you have proven you would make one of the finest.
Is our little hatchling Xan secure in his portable hole?
It always let Mizora track me - let's see if we can make it track her. It's past time for her old pet to sink in his fangs.
Dual wield
Thirteen kith'raki, twenty-five sarths, and three-hundred-five warriors. Precisely.
I wish we didn't have to go back.
I'm in. We'll set out within the tenday.
He is also a near-deity. Should the githzerai join us, we could topple The City of Death in a red dragon's blink.
When I look to the sky, I imagine you atop a red dragon, soaring across the endless night.
Don't worry about me. Takes more than eternal war to knock me on my ass.
Where are you now, that you couldn't be here in the flesh?
I am glad you and Karlach have an enduring friendship - it shall serve as a strong lesson for the children, as well as a stirring tale.
Improvised Letter
I do miss the luxuries this plane has to offer, but I must say - Avernus is second to none when it comes to bloodshed.
You're joking? I wouldn't miss this for the world.
*Your heart can take the strain of leaving Avernus for a short time, but it might burst with joy to feel the comforts of home, if just for an evening.*
Boo! What happened?! The Duke was not meant to die from such a blow. Did the Absolute do this?
Touching
Ah - your endless charms are exceeded only by your endless appetites, Astarion.
Do you ever regret that we did not take control of the Netherbrain?
I should gift you some ear-plugs the next time I see you then. But I know you'll be able to keep Mizora in her place.
Lady Shar will forgive me for a night's indulgence. You look splendid in either case - I may keep you clothed for longer than usual, this time.
It's lovely, thank you.
Interesting. If the chance should arise for you to thwart Shar in some way, assume you have my support.
*Your heart can take the strain of leaving Avernus for a short time, but it might burst with joy to feel the comforts of home, if just for an evening.*
Perhaps it was. If so, it is a madness that fits me well.
Where would I find you?
Shadowheart: you look positively perfect.
Yes! Yes, I'll rule it! I'll be better!
I do. I approach the gates of Shra'kt'lor even now.
*The creature approaches. This ground is forbidden to your kind.*
Stop the Netherbrain. Help my friends... as they helped me.
I will talk to my Father, see if his Fists can take on more of your work.
Suggest Reward ~ [1]/[2]

But don't be such a stranger either, in future. Should Withers grant you leave from Avernus, you'll know where to find me - I can always make some time for an old friend. One of the privileges of being in charge.
I was hoping you might like a new companion - rather large, feathered, well-mannered, mostly...
|I fullfilled my part, so I think we're done here.|
My own blade's dulled a bit, I'm afraid. Unless you count the boars I've slain on ceremonial hunts, I haven't felled a single beast since the Absolute fell.
Don't be like that - it didn't mean anything.
I almost feel sorry for the devils in your path. I mean, I don't, of course. I'm sure they deserve it.
It's just an honour to hear the Lord of Song play such beautiful music.
It is well for Happy the strange portal appeared when it did. Minsc's arm was growing achesome.
Rest up, soldier. My tin can'll be all right for the night. And you and me will get to sleep with both eyes shut for the first time in... six months?
Red & Black
I think on the next place to visit. There is a wizard in Thay who I swore to check up on now and again...
I loved her so much. It isn't fair.
I wish we could have cured her... fixed her... stopped this somehow.
Received
If I must, I must.
She helps the city to prosper, if you can believe it.
I was not asking for it. Htak'a!
Oh, don't mind me. I'm only your oldest friend and your mother's most voluble confidant. Do whatever you please, I don't mind!
*All this stimulating conversation leaves you hungry.*
I do expect you to bow, actually. Do it.
You could at least offer to help!
Sorry, Tara. I'm in the middle of an astral war against a despotic goddess and her army of devoted warriors. I've not found time to write...
Ambition drove Cazador's cruelty, made him do unspeakable things. You'd really help the likes of him?
Most illithids prefer to dominate their thralls through transformation, yet here you stand, untransformed.
Goblin Camp Prison
Right Behind You
They have! I've indulged every vice I had and discovered some new ones.
For spells that don't shoot a projectile, the targets need to be close enough together.
In a manner of speaking, yes... Though it is a more complex, evolving beast than I could ever have anticipated. True balance is no simple, fixed thing. I see that now.
We have had some fun, haven't we?
My home is with Astarion.
Camera Rotate Left
I've missed travelling with you. You were a pleasure to be around.
I might just take you up on that.
Pagh! Is it you who paints the air, Boo? No more Amnian cheeses for you.
Have you found anything to help fix Karlach's engine?
I'll come back to you. I promise.
To the greatest friends I could dream of.
She manipulated me into it. It meant nothing, I swear.
I wouldn't say no to a big feeding. I'd hate for all those memories to go to waste.
What? He died? That was... uncalled-for.
I want nothing more, Gale. When the Blood War is over, I'm coming home to you.
So, you chose this. Over Baldur's Gate, over your friends, over us... you chose this...
If the inhabitants taste anything like they smell, you have peculiar taste indeed.
Mizora's next on the kill list. How did the diabolist visit in Calimshan go?
I've been staying alive in Avernus - barely. Hoping for a cure for this heart soon, though.
Soon - soon I'll find some way to see you in flesh. To touch you as you are meant to be touched.
The wyrm is dead, but his spirit lives within me. I am the Heart of the Gate, the Blade of Frontiers!
Really? I'm amazed they're doing as well as that - I was sure every one would be half-dead in the muck.
I found your people. I'm afraid they didn't survive.
I love you, Lae'zel. To fight at your side is an honour and a pleasure.
Pose E
'Most Dangerous Vocation' - Pamphlet Editor Bonica Moy Speaks Out
In the last half year, we only checked once for the book in our belongings. It had gone. Where, why, or how - we know not.
Cloudkill
We killed so many together...
The feeling's mutual.
It's time - you deserve your freedom from the fires. I can't believe it's almost in reach.
Well - that's enough sentiment for one day. What did you need?
You are who you were meant to be. Your own man. And, as ever, as always - my hero.
Any ambition but to serve Lady Shar is a folly. Her eternal darkness shall swallow all dreams, in the end.
But you could be so much more. Trust me - I am ambition incarnate, and like seeks like. I sense it within you, even if you don't.
Fresh Stock: An Interview With the New Master of Ramazith's Tower
Ornate Love Frame
Ahem. Not in front of Tara, please.
What about the spawn? How are you feeding them?
How do you think the rebuilding is going?
*Scritch-scratch, scritch-scratch, one day you will excavate all the way down to your thrumming heart.*
